clue.text: Thoughtful writers I have to follow

indicators.note: says the I-have letters come after the writers

parts.note: pens are writing instruments, so writers

explanation.surface: Someone reflects that they must queue up behind a group of authors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Writers' looks like people but means pens.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a person lost in thought is reflective, deep in contemplation.

clue.text: Prudent management shows class of airline

definitions.meaning: careful, thrifty handling of resources
the cheapest cabin class on a passenger flight

explanation.surface: A budget carrier's seating plan reveals sensible financial running.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: thrift in managing money, and the basic travel class below business.

clue.text: Period one could see as emptier

indicators.note: one could view the letters of the following words differently, rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A stretch of time that strikes someone as rather empty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one could see' signals that the letters of AS EMPTIER are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Leisure is a stretch of hours left over when work is done, vacant with nothing scheduled.

clue.text: Flower — love it to bits

indicators.note: loving something to bits is the surface idiom; here the words are broken into bits and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Someone adores a bloom, loving it to bits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to bits' reads as the idiom of affection but signals that LOVEIT is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a small purple woodland bloom, one particular plant species.

clue.text: Leave the ground: why I have to use the stairs?

definitions.meaning: to rise into the air, as a rocket at launch

definitions.text: why I have to use the stairs?
definitions.meaning: read as two words: the elevator is off, out of service, so one must walk

explanation.surface: Someone wonders why they must climb on foot rather than take off.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a launch into the air, and an elevator switched off forcing a walk up.

clue.text: Emphatically how contract may be reached

definitions.meaning: in abundance, to a great degree
in the card game bridge a contract is bid in a suit, such as the black suit with the pointed symbol

explanation.surface: An agreement is sealed with great emphasis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contract' suggests a legal deal; it is the bid in bridge, the card game.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: having something in abundance means in large measure; also a bridge contract named in one suit.

clue.text: Swollen stomach: girl's knocked up

indicators.note: in a down clue, sent upwards means the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: Di is a girl's name; the 's stands for 'is' and links

explanation.surface: A girl's swollen belly suggests a pregnancy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked up' looks like slang for pregnant but reverses DI to ID beneath TUM.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: bloated or distended, puffed up beyond normal size.

clue.text: Pottery smashed by fiancee

indicators.note: broken to pieces, so the letters of the word fiancee are reassembled

explanation.surface: Crockery broken by a bride-to-be.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: glazed earthenware of a decorated kind, named after the Italian town Faenza.

clue.text: Unsightly dirt spread by producers of consumer goods

indicators.note: scattered about, so the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Factories making household goods scatter ugly filth around.
explanation.definitionFit: Collective term: the manufacturing sector making smaller everyday products rather than heavy machinery.

clue.text: Also about to seize island

indicators.note: the also word goes around the seize word

parts.note: to bag something is to grab it

explanation.surface: A force is also poised to capture an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Caribbean island paired with Trinidad in one nation.

clue.text: This has one in mansion tossing and turning

definitions.text: This has one in mansion tossing and turning

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: restless movement in bed; the letters roll into a new order

explanation.surface: A person lying awake in a grand house, restless all night.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: someone suffering this lies tossing and turning. 'in' just places the one in the mansion before shuffling.
explanation.definitionFit: The condition of sleeplessness leaves a sufferer restless in bed all night.

clue.text: Delay girl's return

indicators.note: to come back, so the letters run the other way

parts.note: gal is a girl; the 's stands for 'is' and links

explanation.surface: A girl's homecoming is held up.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a time gap or slowing, as in jet lag.

clue.text: Religious leader you once made into cartoon character

parts.note: the Pope heads the Catholic Church
ye is the archaic form of you

explanation.surface: A pontiff turned someone into an animated figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the spinach-eating sailor of comic strips and animation.

clue.text: Stockpiling a large display board

definitions.meaning: storing up supplies
a big outdoor board for posters, a billboard in British usage

explanation.surface: A huge advertising board promotes stocking up.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: amassing goods, and the British word for a billboard.

clue.text: From fancy niche one takes a jaundiced view

indicators.note: the letters are taken from within the two words

explanation.surface: From a smart alcove someone looks out sourly.
explanation.definitionFit: A doubter who believes everyone acts from self-interest sees the world sourly.

clue.text: Incompatible ingredients in strong spirit

definitions.meaning: flame and liquid, two elements that cannot coexist
crude, potent liquor

explanation.surface: A potent drink mixed from things that should not go together.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the clashing elements flame and liquid, and slang for strong alcohol.

clue.text: Hypotenuse is close

definitions.meaning: the longest edge of a right triangle
near, beside

explanation.surface: A geometry remark that a triangle's longest edge is near.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the triangle's lengthiest edge, read in pieces, and next to or beside.

clue.text: A regular figure in defence of America

definitions.meaning: a five-sided shape with equal sides
the US Department of Defense headquarters, named for its five-sided building

explanation.surface: A standard shape appears in American military planning.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a five-sided polygon, and the US defence ministry housed in that shape.

clue.text: Prepare to forge currency

definitions.meaning: get things set up
to manufacture cash, as ready is slang for money

explanation.surface: A counterfeiter gets ready to print fake notes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the ready' is British slang for cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to get set up, and literally to produce cash, slang 'ready money'.

clue.text: Small reduction is unfair

definitions.meaning: a little taken away
British informal: not quite acceptable or fair

explanation.surface: A shopper grumbles that a tiny discount is a poor deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a modest cut, and the British idiom for slightly unreasonable behaviour.

clue.text: Daughter finished the port

explanation.surface: A daughter polished off the after-dinner wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'port' reads as wine but is a harbour: DOVER is the English Channel ferry town.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Kent harbour town facing France across the Channel.

clue.text: General change is swell

indicators.note: to alter, so the letters of the word general are reordered

explanation.surface: An officer declares that broad change is excellent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swell' reads as an adjective meaning great, but is the verb to grow.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to swell is to grow bigger, expand.

clue.text: In fish, a length of bone

explanation.surface: Inside a fish lies a long piece of skeleton.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: one of the eight small wrist bones.

clue.text: Sharp replies to stories circulating about parking

indicators.note: the shuffled stories go around the parking letter
moving round, so the letters of stories are recirculated

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Pointed retorts to rumours about a car park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circulating' turns STORIES into RIOSTES, and 'about' wraps it around P.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: quick, witty retorts, from the fencing term for a return thrust.

clue.text: Old and sullen by repute

explanation.surface: Someone is known as elderly and grumpy.
explanation.definitionFit: Reputation sense: being in good or bad standing with others, as in 'odour of sanctity'.

clue.text: An upper-class girl? A girl

parts.note: gel is the posh British pronunciation of girl

explanation.surface: Asking whether a young woman is a posh lady.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a woman's first name, given to girls.

clue.text: The high point of a Devon holiday

definitions.text: The high point of a Devon holiday

parts.words: The high point of a Devon holiday
parts.note: Devon, an English county with Dartmoor, has rocky hilltops; the best moment of a trip is read as a literal summit

explanation.surface: The best moment of a vacation in the West Country.
explanation.walkthrough: Devon is a county in south-west England, home to Dartmoor.
explanation.definitionFit: A rocky hill peak, typical of Dartmoor in the West Country.

clue.text: Just this big? Not any more

definitions.meaning: asking whether something measures no more than this length
having ceased, formerly but not now

explanation.surface: Someone asks if an item is only this size and is told it has shrunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: not exceeding this length, and an idiom for something that has ceased.

clue.text: Supports holding large implement

indicators.note: the supports enclose the large letter

parts.note: piers are pillars that support a bridge

explanation.surface: Pillars grip a big tool.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a gripping tool with two hinged jaws.

clue.text: Insult a political organisation in speech

indicators.note: spoken, so the words are taken by their sound

parts.note: a front is a political grouping, as in National Front

explanation.surface: A political party is slighted in a speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an open slight or offence to someone's dignity.

clue.text: One inactive as supporter of the railway

definitions.meaning: a dormant agent or someone who sleeps
a British term for a tie, the beam laid under the rails

explanation.surface: An idle person serves as a fan of the train line.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the beams beneath railway tracks are called by this name, not ties.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: someone dormant, and the timber or concrete beam holding rails.
